profile_text.body:
The Alignment Research Center, which goes by ARC, is a non-profit research organization founded in 2021 and based in Berkeley, California. Its stated mission is to align future machine learning systems with human interests. The organization describes itself as expecting that new techniques will be needed to align AI systems as they surpass human capabilities, and it argues that progress in AI may accelerate faster than methods can be adapted to keep up.

ARC's own framing of the problem is that alignment methods should be safely scalable over many orders of magnitude, in the way that generative pretraining and reinforcement learning have been scaled up over the past decade. The material available lists no products from the organization, and no lawsuits involving it are noted.
